name: Lan Media
subtitle: Local HTTP File Server
description: Turn your phone into a local Wi-Fi server to share photos, videos, and folders with no internet, no account, and no cloud required. Other devices don't need the app installed—simply open the provided link or scan the QR code in any Web Browser to stream or download instantly.
